True Anomaly develops autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors for space superiority. The Software Engineer I will develop distributed spacecraft ground control systems in Elixir, contributing to satellite command and control, mission planning, mission data processing, data analysis, architecture, design, and code reviews.
